signal_grades.note: Each signal is tested on its own: when it appeared, did PHG move the way it predicts 5 trading days later (daily) or 7 hours later (hourly)? "Helpful" means right at least 58% of the time with a positive average move, "Misleading" means wrong more often than right, and "Too few" means under 10 examples so far.

today_paragraph: Philips is at $26.55, down 1.3% today. Price is back above its 20-day average, but the longer trend hasn't turned up yet. The overall score is neutral (+12), so signals are mixed. Options look expensive, assuming 40% yearly volatility versus 21% the stock has actually shown. The options market expects a move of about ±8% by Nov 20. Next up: Philips earnings (before open) in 8 days. Earnings have moved it about ±8% on average. Option prices often drop sharply right after the report.
